Interface PieceReader<T>

Type Parameters:
T - The type of an element
All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, Closeable
All Known Implementing Classes:
BodyPieces
public interface PieceReader<T> extends Closeable
Reader of the elements of one body, fed the pieces of the body as they arrive, without Reactive Streams: the reading counterpart of PieceWriter. Opened by ChunkedMessageBodyReader.openPieceReader(Argument, MediaType, Headers, long), it keeps the state across the pieces, e.g. a JSON value split between two pieces.

An element is decoded when it is polled, not when the piece that completes it is read: a reader that pulls one element at a time decodes nothing ahead of its caller, and holds the bytes of the elements it has not polled yet.

An element that poll() returns is handed over to the caller: an element that holds resources, e.g. a reference counted buffer, is released by the caller. The reader releases the pieces it was fed, and, when it is closed, the bytes of the elements it holds that were not polled.

The methods are called one at a time, never concurrently, but successive calls may come from different threads. Input pieces are byte buffers; decoded elements are values returned by poll() and must never be null. Elements completed before read(ReadBuffer) or complete() fails remain available to poll().

5.3.0

  • Method Details

    • read

      void read(ReadBuffer piece) throws IOException
      Read the next piece of the body. The reader takes over the piece: it closes it, also when reading fails.
      Parameters:
      piece - The piece
      Throws:
      IOException - If the input is malformed, e.g. a io.micronaut.json.JsonSyntaxException
      CodecException - If the piece cannot be read
      ContentLengthExceededException - If an element exceeds the limit supplied when opening the reader

    • complete

      void complete() throws IOException
      The end of the body: the elements that only the end completes, e.g. a number at the end of a JSON stream, become available.
      Throws:
      IOException - If the body ends inside an element

    • poll

      @Nullable T poll() throws IOException
      Decode the next element that the pieces read so far complete.
      Returns:
      The element, or null if the pieces read so far complete no other element: more pieces are needed, or, after complete(), there are no more elements
      Throws:
      IOException - If the input is malformed
      CodecException - If the element cannot be decoded

    • isEmpty

      default boolean isEmpty()
      Whether the pieces read so far are known to complete no other element, without decoding one: poll() would return null. A caller that has no demand for another element uses it to discover the end of the elements after complete(), where polling would decode an element that nobody requested.
      Returns:
      true if no element is available; false if one may be, also when the reader cannot tell without decoding (the default): the caller then waits for a request to poll()

    • close

      void close()
      Release what the reader holds, e.g. the bytes of a partial element, or of the elements that were not polled. May be called more than once.
